source_user: A service receives a mix of short prompts and long generations. Design an evaluation plan that reports TTFT, TPOT, throughput, queueing, and P99 latency. Scenario variant 191: include an explicit falsifiable hypothesis and a controlled experiment.
source_assistant: Answer should state assumptions, a falsifiable hypothesis, measurements, expected confounders, and rollback criteria. Minimum technical points: separate prefill and decode behavior; fix workload distribution; report warmup; use repeated trials; capture GPU memory and request-level traces.
corrected_answer: Assume two identical deployments differing only in the candidate. Fix model, tokenizer, precision, hardware, versions, batching, concurrency, arrivals, and seeds. Replay an immutable trace stratified by prompt/output length and load, randomize matched A/B blocks, remove declared warm-up, and run at least five paired repetitions. Hypothesis for variant 191: candidate SLO-goodput improves by >=10% while error rate and end-to-end P99 increase by <=5%; prespecified confidence intervals determine falsification. Timestamp ingress, admission, queue release, prefill start/end, first token, decode tokens, completion, timeout, and cancellation. Define TTFT queue-inclusive and compute-only, TPOT with first-token and generated-token rules, output tokens/s, queue wait, and P99 population/failure policy; report units, medians, tails, intervals, and strata. Capture correctness, failures, queue/batch state, GPU/KV/total memory and utilization, CPU/RAM, power, temperature, throttling, plus raw synchronized traces and config manifests. Record cache/order, background load, autoscaling, compilation, network, retries, thermal state, and drift as confounders. Canary and revert on correctness, OOM, instability, thermal, or repeated SLO violations; conclusions remain provisional.
risks: Provisional metrics are sensitive to workload mix, denominators, warm-up, and environmental confounders.
evidence_required: Immutable trace/config manifests
Raw synchronized request and system telemetry
Repeated paired runs with uncertainty analysis
